source: NY State Adjutant-General's Roster — 60th Infantry (NY State Military Museum / DMNA)
query_used: Downloaded the 175-page roster PDF (real text layer, 344,959 chars via pdfplumber); case-insensitive full-text scan for HUBBELL/HUBBEL/HUBBLE/HUBEL and fuzzy H..B..EL surnames. Located at PDF p.81, printed running-header page 737 ('SIXTIETH INFANTRY. 737').

raw_record.verbatim: HUBBELL, ALEXANDER F.—Age, 18 years. Enlisted, September 21, 1861, at Champlain, to serve three years; mustered in as corporal, Co. H, October 30, 1861; promoted sergeant, October 1, 1862; re-enlisted as a veteran, December 14, 1863; mustered out with company, July 17, 1865, at Alexandria, Va.
raw_record.ocr_note: Em-dash after surname extracted as a replacement char; elsewhere in the PDF 'Co.' sometimes OCR'd 'Oo.' and dates as '18.61'. The Hubbell line itself extracted cleanly — names, dates, company all legible.

candidates.claude_reasoning: C1 (dispositive): regiment 60th NY + Company H match the curated assignment, and a full-text scan of the ENTIRE roster (~1,371 headwords) returned exactly ONE Hubbell — no competing Hubbell in the regiment (nearest neighbors HOBART, HUCKINS). C2 (strong): enlistment 1861-09-21 and reenlistment 1863-12-14 fall inside the known window. C4 (strong): enlistment place 'Champlain' matches the family's distinctive hometown. C6 (supporting): rank trajectory corporal→sergeant→veteran matches the letters and genealogy. No criteria against (two date discrepancies are intra-record day/transcription variants, filed separately, not contradictions of identity).

verified_matches.name: Alexander F. Hubbell
new_or_sharpened_facts_vs_letters: Exact enlistment place confirmed as Champlain (matches family); age 18 confirmed (b. c. 1843–1844).
Re-enlistment as a veteran 1863-12-14 confirmed against an official record (family genealogy agreed).
Muster-out recorded as July 17 1865 (family record said July 7 — see discrepancy).
Sergeant promotion recorded as October 1 1862 (family record said Oct 21 — see discrepancy).

uniqueness: Exactly one HUBBELL in the entire 60th NY roster — dispositive for identity (no disambiguation needed).
notes: Authoritative primary roster from the NY Adjutant-General's registers. Independently corroborated by Richard Eddy's 1864 regimental history (regimental-bibliography.json), which names A. F. Hubbell in the Co. H organization roll AND in the Lookout Mountain wounded list. The color-bearer role and ambulance-corps service from the letters are NOT in this roster (rosters record rank/company/fate, not duty assignments).
